notes.title: Vorax at Gamescom with Open Alpha Ready to Play
notes.content:
[h1]HUGE Progress Update on our newest game[/h1]
[url=https://freebies.indiegala.com/vorax-alpha][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42117934/e720f54b3a2868a7d11c877b3123dd2b65ef0c84.jpg[/img][/url]
We know we usually don't post about this that often, sorry for the long post, but this is a special occasion that we wanted to share with all the community, thank you for your patience. More surprises are coming soon. You can try the updated [url=https://freebies.indiegala.com/vorax-alpha]Open Alpha[/url] or Demo for [b]FREE[/b] today.

In just a few days we will be present at Gamescom 2023, in Germany. You will be able to find us in hall 10.1 booth B-093 and hall 02.1 stand A-0007.

But for those at home, who can't make it, we also have [b]something [b]HUGE[/b] for you.[/b] Gain access to a 10 times bigger map (10 square kilometers), vehicles, new weapons and zones. Find out more.

[previewyoutube=AwZUSuHQsYs;full][/previewyoutube]

An updated Steam demo and an updated full build. Also [b]exclusive open alpha opportunity[/b] for the most loyal fans. 

We are talking about new weapons, an expanded map, new enemies and a whole lot more.

[h2]Updated Steam Demo & Open Alpha[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1874190/Vorax/

If you do not own it yet on Steam, it's fine. You can play the Updated Demo on Steam right now. It's [b]free[/b], it has most of the new elements added to it, you can get a taste of what's to come at Gamescom. Even if on a smaller map (only 1km2), the horror and survival will be the same, just in a smaller dose. 

[url=https://freebies.indiegala.com/vorax-alpha][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42117934/5bd4cd61393d3c1040ab090db02f2e64ffe8d4fd.jpg[/img][/url]

If you are interested to spice the experience, you can try the [url=https://freebies.indiegala.com/vorax-alpha][b]Open Alpha[/b] on our website[/url]. Which, it brings all of the above mentioned plus two exclusive weapons: SAP-6 and the AK-47. With these bad boys at your side your survival chances will exponentially grow...if you find the ammo for them. Find them somewhere well hidden on the map.

[url=https://freebies.indiegala.com/vorax-alpha][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42117934/8a01ee88bc3cad223cb590cf9685853ae1c01d55.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Something [b]HUGE[/b] for those who got Full Game Early[/h2]

Not only you will get access to everything mentioned earlier, but also the possibility to explore the full map. Nearly 10 times bigger [u](10 square kilometers)[/u], with vehicles, new weapons, new enemies and a lot more. Your experience will be close to similar to those from Gamescom.

[url=https://vorax.indiegala.com/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42117934/db9fab173a6ab7412c069efa1d9702ffa85a90e9.jpg[/img][/url]

If you haven't bought it already, you can get it directly, early and cheaper from [url=https://vorax.indiegala.com/]our website[/url] and support our development progress. If you did, you can already head to your profile library and download the new updated build right now. Keep in mind it does get updated regularly, so you can check back again later for something new.

[url=https://vorax.indiegala.com/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42117934/9011f1e1c6c6347a0d12bdb49ecd11648e605e51.jpg[/img][/url]

And yes, of course, you will also get a Steam Key as soon as it releases on Steam, you will not be forgotten. But in the meantime, make sure you wishlist it, if you haven't already. And if you will be in Cologne next week, see you there, let's meet.

[previewyoutube=qES69bfFKAk;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Wishlist now:[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1874190/Vorax/
[url=https://discord.gg/bXnMMb3Yrc][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3402923/5bb2433aad01fce79766323ac1cd5fb9c55d7a59.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Русский язык, Idioma español, cards & more in Die Young patch 1.0.30.20!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3402923/da036d4efbcfee2c58222afcea03af587dd7b801.jpg[/img]
Hi Everybody!

Today we are very proud to announce a majore release patch for Die Young.
1.0.30.20 where many things were added, 
the most important are [b]RUSSIAN [/b]and [b]SPANISH [/b]languages!

Since its release the 12 of September, thousands of you played Die Young and we are very happy.

We are still finalizing Italian ( it's our native language so we want to make things right ;-) ) and it should be ready for next week when also official soundtrack will be released.

We also add Trading cards in this patch, we hope you like it!

Full changelog 1.0.30.20
[list]
[*] added Russian language
[*] added Spanish language
[*] The executioner now despawns after crossing Underworld Passage
[*] Now the Executioner keys (Blood-soaked Keys) also open the gates of the passage that directly connects Dry Riverbed and Stone Pillars.
[*] fix of some quests that were not completed correctly
[*] graphix fixes/ improvements on several textures
[*] graphix fixes/ improvements on several npc animations
[*] graphix fixes/ improvements on several first person animations
[*] further level and geometry optimization.
[/list]

notes.title: Die Young: Prologue is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]Play Die Young: Prologue now![/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/973000/Die_Young_Prologue/

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/973000/Die_Young_Prologue/][img]https://i.imgur.com/sWFXqKK.jpg[/img][/url]

Get ready to slowly merge into Die Young's full story starting right from the roots! 

Play as Nehir, a field agent of a well-known political party trying to deconstruct and eliminate Brother n.1, the leader of Island's community. 

The Prologue covers her desperate attempt to reach the rendezvous point. Will she be able to save herself or will she die young?


Die Young: Prologue is an action-adventure with a more linear structure than the open-world of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/433170/Die_Young/]Die Young[/url], but it leaves the player with the possibility of using different approaches and paths to escape.
The game consists of three levels: Introductory, Main, Final. 
If players choose to explore these levels, they'll discover several useful items that'll unravel the deep lore behind Die Young.

We hope you enjoy this free prequel game!

tags.feature: Die Young: Prologue is now available on Steam!

notes.title: Update 1.5.0 and new Heroes of Red Rope!
notes.content:
Update 1.5.0 is live, but first of all we want to celebrate three new heroes of Red Rope!
These are people who managed to get out of the Labyrinth and therefore received a portrait by our pixel artist, Francesca, and became characters in the game world!

Here's Mopati, a solo hero:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25301239/aff29361d1e052661d039fdf0eb64ae7c1d3e55a.png[/img]

And here we have Stacy and Caleb, who completed the game together:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25301239/e51ed1222d3bfd267f9278df7d409e26bddddf22.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25301239/65f4a446b9e8097578e2f54e7a72b4d5c78efb8d.png[/img]

Here you can find their beautiful let's play series: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6nGMwhwHEOs&list=PLmIUIJ9T0ytRxJAxOololTQB2o0ABCfA_&index=1

Now, on to the content of this update:
[list]
    [*]A tutorial bronze key was added at the beginning of the game to guide the players towards the open doors leading to the four seasons.
    [*]A blackboard was added at the beginning of the game to make sure new players immediately understand how to open the map, pirouette to reduce the length of the rope and walk.
    [*]The paperboy was changed to warn the players of the opportunity to become characters of the game once exited the Labyrinth.
    [*]The first levels of the houses of spring and autumn were rebalanced.
    [*]Minor bugs were fixed.
[/list]

That's all for today, go and try to exit the Labyrinth!
